checkpoints.description: [1/2] Add a subtle warm amber tint to archived project cards: border, background, accent line and badge, while easing the dimming from 0.74 to 0.82.

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a slight color change on archived cards; the previous treatment only dimmed them in neutral gray.
impact_assessment.benefits: Archived status is recognizable by color at a glance without looking like an error state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CSS only, no markup changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse a single --archived token, verify computed colors in browser, run tests and strict gates.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: strip the redundant [ARCHIVED] prefix from displayed descriptions in project cards and dossiers when the repo is archived, leaving GitHub descriptions and catalogue data untouched.

impact_assessment.why: Archived cards now have an explicit badge and styling, so the [ARCHIVED] text in descriptions is duplicated noise; the source data should stay byte-identical.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cleaner cards and dossier copy; no sync churn or data changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests pin static HTML and README descriptions; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: presentation only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure displayDescription helper used only by browser renderers, with a failing-first unit test; static HTML/data stay unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: (1) bump shell/script cache version to v46; (2) fix unlabeled controls in live app sources and re-sync snapshots; (3) measure performance with browser trace and apply justified optimizations; (4) show verifier snapshot freshness; (5) triage reports inbox to its cap.

impact_assessment.why: The user approved the five recommended improvements; returning browsers serve stale JS, 12 live snapshots have a11y findings, performance is unmeasured, the verifier fallback has no freshness signal, and the reports inbox is far over cap.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deploy reaches visitors, live apps are accessible, performance is evidence-based, verifier is honest about snapshot age, workspace debt is reduced.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: version/version tests and live build digests are pinned; dependency: upstream app sources and sync tool; concurrency: other sessions edit rust/ and reports/; state: many files across three repos
impact_assessment.mitigation: Work one milestone at a time with failing-first tests where practical, verify with gates and browser after each, never force push, and leave other sessions' files alone.

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Done: bumped shell version 45 to 46 across SW, APP_VERSION and all versioned script URLs; added aria-labels to 18 controls across 12 live snapshots and refreshed the four affected build digests. A11y audit now 0 findings on all 31 pages; 203 tests OK.

[4/5] Measured with Chromium trace: before 17 long tasks / 8453 ms blocking; after content-visibility on project cards, 1 long task / 46 ms on a fresh origin. Added registerFreshness helper and UI label showing generated/refresh dates. 63 verifier assertions, 203 Python tests OK.
Task 'site-hardening-five' completed successfully.

impact_assessment.why: The previous hardening left verify.html on v20, snapshot labels will be overwritten by live sync, archived cards have no filter, print may hide content, and Lighthouse scores are null.

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: fix the Lighthouse target-size finding on dossier gallery dots, add a target-size check to the local a11y audit, align upstream live-app sources, verify print output, then re-run Lighthouse and all gates. Evidence: project.html?repo=Noesis scored accessibility 0.96 with 6 target-size failures on .gallery-dot buttons; best-practices and SEO were 1.00.

impact_assessment.why: The last measured defect left on the site is the dossier gallery's small touch targets; the DOM audit does not check hit-area size, upstream sources still carry unlabeled controls, and the print rule has only been tested statically.
impact_assessment.benefits: Dossier accessibility reaches 1.00; the audit catches target-size regressions; upstream and site-side labelling converge; print output is verified rather than assumed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: gallery dot markup and tests are pinned; dependency: upstream repos are not checked out locally; concurrency: other sessions edit rust/ and reports/; state: Lighthouse needs a focused visible browser tab
impact_assessment.mitigation: Write a failing-first CSS/audit assertion, keep the sync-tool patch until upstream is fixed, use headless Chromium print-to-PDF if available, and re-run Lighthouse plus 6/6 gates before commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Verified assumptions: .gallery-dot is 8x8 px (Lighthouse target-size cause); audit lacks target-size checks; upstream checkouts absent so sync patch stays; Edge binary available for print-to-PDF. Implementing gallery dot hit-area fix with failing-first test.

[4/4] Complete: gallery and live dots enlarged to 26px hit areas; audit now checks target-size with 0 findings; sync tool label coverage test added; print PDF verified archived cards appear (18 to 29 pages); Lighthouse on dossier now 1.00/1.00/1.00 with 0 failures; 209 tests OK.
Task 'dossier-a11y-polish' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: (1) stop the AIKit dossier from offering dead GitHub links since its repo is private; (2) generate sitemap entries for all dossier pages and test coverage; (3) replace the stale no-JS 'Showing all 48' status copy. Evidence: gh reports AIKit private=true while project.js sets both repo and README links unconditionally; sitemap.xml has 7 URLs and zero project.html URLs; index.html fallback says 48 while the catalogue has 74.

impact_assessment.why: These are three concrete visitor-facing gaps found in the latest review; each is small and independently testable.
impact_assessment.benefits: No dead links, dossiers become indexable, and no-JS copy is honest.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sitemap static URLs and filter-status copy are pinned by tests; dependency: private-repo list is presentation policy; concurrency: none active; state: generated sitemap must stay in sync with catalogue
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing-first tests for each, keep the private list explicit and documented, generate sitemap from repositories.json with a coverage test, then run all gates and browser checks.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Complete: AIKit dossier no longer offers private GitHub links (node tests 92 OK); sitemap generated with 81 URLs covering all 74 dossiers; no-JS status copy replaced; 211 Python tests OK; 6/6 gates pass.
